annotations.text:
Direction C, built out — shadcn neutral, in Geist.

The faces are embedded, so this renders in the product's real type rather than falling back to system-ui like the first pass did. Toggle dark above any artboard.

TYPE & COLOUR
Geist Sans + Geist Mono, embedded from the same woff2 apps/web serves at /fonts.

Mono carries every machine value — URL, commands, counts, key names — and nothing else.

#E63F2C is the accent: primary buttons, the selected tool, the chart and the bar fills. Green stays reserved for status, so 'live' means live and nothing else is allowed to.

STILL OPEN
· The toolbar that opens this is still the old dark bar — it needs to join this system.
· Your display serif is Bitter (from Google), so it is not embedded; this direction does not use one.
· Say go and I build this in drawer.ts against live data.
